title: Saturation, and notation for the full-twist and mass endomorphism
html:
Remark. Saturation, and notation for the full-twist and mass endomorphism

A nuclear shell at nucleon count n \in \mathfrak{M} = \{2, 8, 20, 28, 50, 82, 126\} is saturated in the QOU framework: the algebraic structure of the shell admits no further crossing-energy absorption. The proposition names the categorical content of saturation directly, replacing matrix-evaluation evidence (Hoefsmit seminormal forms at k = 3, \dots, 10, blocked at k \geq 12 by combinatorial growth) with a homological / algebraic-geometry statement about a global section.

Notation

Let \mathbf{C} be the rigid braided monoidal category of the QOU substrate (Frobenius–Hopf object A, fibre functor \tau). For n \in \mathbb{N} write

  • H_n(q) for the Iwahori–Hecke algebra at parameter q, generated by \sigma_1, \dots, \sigma_{n-1} subject to the braid relations and \sigma_i^2 = (q - q^{-1}) \sigma_i + 1;
  • \Delta_n^2 = (\sigma_1 \sigma_2 \cdots \sigma_{n-1})^n \in Z(B_n) for the full-twist generator of the centre of the braid group, mapped under the Hecke quotient to the central element \Delta_n^2 \in Z(H_n(q)) [kassel1995, geckpfeiffer2000];
  • \Phi_n \in \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A^{\otimes n}) for the categorical mass endomorphism at level n — the global section of the mass functor over the rigid braided monoidal category, related to the Hecke-mass element \Phi_{\mathrm{mass}} by \Phi_{\mathrm{mass}}(\beta) = (\tau \otimes \cdots \otimes \tau) \circ \Phi_n \circ \rho(\beta) (Hecke mass element);
  • \mathfrak{M} = \{2, 8, 20, 28, 50, 82, 126\} for the seven observed nuclear magic numbers.
